svg.title: Manufacturing Variances — BPMN teaching model
svg.desc: BPMN teaching proposal with Cost Analyst and Independent Reviewer lanes. A selected close record leads to evidence collection and reconciliation; an exclusive decision leads either to a supported variance explanation or a request for further evidence.
